name: Share Purchase Agreement
suggestion: Please upload the Share Purchase Agreement document to extract the fields.

fields.label: Target
fields.prompt: What is the name of the company which the buyer is seeking to acquire? Respond with the company name and legal entity which the buyer is seeking to acquire.

fields.label: Buyer(s)
fields.prompt: Who are the Buyer(s) listed in the SPA? List the underlying parties (e.g., sponsor or individual owners), along with the legal entities. Mention Not Available if its not provided. Summarize in not more than 50 words.

fields.label: sign split
fields.prompt: complete the folmediuming sentence by selecting the appropriate option: 'the transaction involves a [simultaneous / split] sign and close.'

fields.label: Locked box or completion accounts
fields.prompt: respond with either “locked box” or “completion accounts.”, depending on the pricing mechanism used. Response should be not more than 2 words.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.prompt: If the SPA is governed by laws of Germany, respond with “Laws of the Federal Republic of Germany”, if not please state the Governing Law in not more than 10 words.

fields.label: definition of loss
fields.prompt: Inject the clause number (and the relevant schedule of the SPA, if applicable) of the definition of Loss from the SPA and complete the folmediuming: "Folmedium the definition of Loss as set out in clause [...] of the SPA." If its not defined, dont give empty responce, respond with "[Note to HWF: Loss is not defined in the SPA. Please review the SPA to confirm.]"

fields.label: sellers
fields.prompt: Who are the Seller(s) listed in the SPA? List the underlying parties (e.g., sponsor or individual owners), along with the legal entities. Summarize in not more than 50 words.

fields.label: disclosed
fields.prompt:
If the term “Disclosed” is defined in the SPA, complete the following sentence with the relevant clause reference:
“Follow the definition of ‘Disclosed’ as set out in clause [●] of the SPA.”
If the term disclosed is not defined in the SPA, please respond with "Note to HWF: The term 'Disclosed' is not defined in the SPA. Delete this row and include the next row below."
